description: This file defines the DbusMgr class which manages D-Bus connections and proxies for NetworkManager components on a Linux system, including connection handling, proxy creation for various NetworkManager interfaces, and error handling.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class that manages D-Bus connections and proxies for NetworkManager, providing methods to create proxies for various NetworkManager interfaces and handle connection lifecycle.

methods.name: DbusMgr
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the D-Bus connection.

methods.name: ~DbusMgr
methods.description: Destructor that releases the D-Bus connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current D-Bus connection, reconnecting if necessary.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for the NetworkManager interface.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for the NetworkManager Settings interface.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsConnectionProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for a specific NetworkManager Settings Connection.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDeviceProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for a NetworkManager device.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerActiveConnProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for an active NetworkManager connection.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerAccessPointProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for a NetworkManager access point.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerWirelessProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for a Wireless device.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv4Proxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for IPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv6Proxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for IPv6 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv4Proxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for DHCPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv6Proxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for DHCPv6 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy for device properties.
